name: skip-intro-appear
intent: A contextual SKIP INTRO action fades in only while the simulated intro segment is skippable, and disappears the moment it ends.

phases.intro: skip button appears at 400ms, clock ticks 00:00-00:03
phases.episode: entered on skip click or automatically at 3000ms; button hidden and non-interactive

triggers.skip: SKIP INTRO button, only while phase is intro
triggers.replay: REPLAY button restarts the whole sequence

a11y.liveStatus: polite text reporting phase and elapsed time

reducedMotion.behaviour: Skip button still appears/disappears on the same schedule with no transition
